scope: Targeted 061 claims only, not blanket approval of 061–070

claims.summary: Maze of Ith first printed in The Dark, Aug 1 1994; illustrator Anson Maddocks.
Maze can target an untapped attacker; it remains attacking, combat damage by and to the target is prevented, postdamage untapping does not undo damage, and Maze has no mana ability.
Mark Arce's Mono Black list at the 2015 Old School Eternal Weekend publishes one Maze of Ith, four Hypnotic Specters, fourteen Swamps; Maze appears in business rather than mana sources.
Serra Angel/Kird Ape/Taiga opponent is a plausible illustrated Old School matchup, not a source-attributed actual opponent; correct modern-rules timing and 6→4 damage are author-checked.
